cohort_description: Patients diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes in the last year
cohort_query: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE diagnosis = 'diabetes' AND diagnosis_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year'

cohort_description: Matched control group for diabetes cohort
cohort_query: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE diagnosis IS NULL AND age BETWEEN 40 AND 60

cohort_description: Head and neck cancer survivors 6 months post-treatment
cohort_query: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE cancer_type = 'HNC' AND treatment_end_date <= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'
